server_path.markdownDescription:
The path to the server binary to use for starting the language server. Use `auto` for the package to manage (install/update) server automatically.

> [!NOTE]
> Change this instead of directly updating `command` - the `${server_path}` variable is dynamically resolved based on this setting.

> [!WARNING]
> Using custom binary could result in package settings not matching what server supports.

angular.log.description: Enables logging of the Angular server to a file. This log can be used to diagnose Angular Server issues. The log is written to `ngls.log` in the `server` directory of the package storage (`$cache/Package Storage/LSP-angular`). The log may contain file paths, source code, and other potentially sensitive information from your project. Requires restarting the server.

angular.enable-strict-mode-prompt.markdownDescription: Prompt to enable the [strictTemplates](https://angular.dev/reference/configs/angular-compiler-options#stricttemplates) flag in [angularCompilerOptions](https://angular.dev/reference/configs/angular-compiler-options).

angular.suggest.includeAutomaticOptional.markdownDescription: Enable showing completions on potentially undefined values that insert an optional chain call. Requires TS 3.7+ and strict null checks to be enabled.

angular.suggest.includeCompletionsWithSn.markdownDescription: Enable snippet completions from Angular language server. Requires using TypeScript 4.3+ in the workspace.

angular.suggest.autoImports.markdownDescription: Enable/disable auto import suggestions for the exported Angular components from the current project.

angular.forceStrictTemplates.markdownDescription: Enabling this option will force the language service to use [strictTemplates](https://angular.dev/reference/configs/angular-compiler-options#stricttemplates) and ignore the user settings in the `tsconfig.json`.

angular.suppressAngularDiagnosticCodes.markdownDescription: A comma-separated list of error codes in templates whose diagnostics should be ignored.

angular.documentSymbols.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable Angular-specific document symbols in Goto Symbol. Shows control flow blocks (`@if`, `@for`, `@defer`), elements, variables, and structural directives.

angular.documentSymbols.showImplicitForV.markdownDescription: Show all implicit `@for` loop variables (`$index`, `$count`, `$first`, `$last`, `$even`, `$odd`) in document symbols. When disabled (default), only explicitly aliased variables like `let i = $index` are shown.

angular.inlayHints.bindingHints.pipeOutp.markdownDescription:
Show type hints for pipe output types.

Example:

```html
{{ value | async /* : User | null */ }}
```

angular.inlayHints.bindingHints.property.markdownDescription:
Show type hints for property/input bindings.

Example:

```html
<cmp [disabled /* : boolean */]="flag" />
```

angular.inlayHints.bindingHints.required.markdownDescription:
Visual indicator for required inputs. `'asterisk'` shows `*`, `'exclamation'` shows `!` after the type.

Example:

```html
<cmp [requiredInput /* : string* */]="value" />
```

angular.inlayHints.bindingHints.twoWayBi.markdownDescription:
Show signal type hints for two-way bindings.

Example:

```html
<cmp [(value /* : WritableSignal<string> */)]="model" />
```

angular.inlayHints.eventHints.parameterT.markdownDescription:
Show type hints for event binding `$event` parameter.

Example:

```html
<button (click)="onClick($event /* : MouseEvent */)"></button>
```

angular.inlayHints.functionTypes.arrowFu.markdownDescription:
Show type hints for arrow function parameters in templates.

Example:

```html
{{ value | apply : (x /* : number */) => x * 2 }}
```

Show return type hints for arrow functions in templates.

Example:

```html
{{ value | apply : (x) /* : number */ => x * 2 }}
```

angular.inlayHints.interaction.interacti.markdownDescription:
Enable interactive inlay hints that navigate to definitions when clicked.

Example:

```html
{{ formatAmount(/* precision: */ 2) }}
```

With this enabled, hint parts can be navigated.

angular.inlayHints.parameterHints.nameHi.markdownDescription:
Show parameter name hints for function/method calls. `'literals'` shows hints only for literal arguments.

Example:

```html
{{ formatAmount(/* value: */ amount, /* precision: */ 2) }}
```

angular.inlayHints.parameterHints.suppre.markdownDescription:
Suppress parameter name hints when argument name matches parameter name.

Example:

```html
{{ onClick(user) }}
```

When enabled, suppresses hints where argument text already conveys the same name.

angular.inlayHints.variableTypes.letDecl.markdownDescription:
Show type hints for `@let` declarations.

Example:

```html
@let count /* : number */ = items.length
```

angular.inlayHints.variableTypes.referen.markdownDescription:
Show type hints for template reference variables.

Example:

```html
<input #input /* : HTMLInputElement */ />
```

angular.inlayHints.variableTypes.suppres.markdownDescription:
Suppress variable type hints when variable name matches type name (case-insensitive).

Example:

```html
@let user = getUser()
```

When enabled, suppresses `/* : User */` for names like `user: User`.

angular.server.useClientSideFileWatcher.markdownDescription:
When enabled, the Angular Language Service delegates file watching to Sublime Text instead of creating its own internal file watchers. This can significantly improve performance and reduce resource usage in large repositories.

> [!NOTE]
> Requires a file watcher package, for example [LSP-file-watcher-rust](https://packagecontrol.io/packages/LSP-file-watcher-rust). Without it the server is not notified about file changes.
